scenario.title: The Unsettled Gym Partner
scenario.description: After a strenuous workout session at their local gym, John and his gym partner, Alex, are cooling down. John notices that Alex seems unusually quiet and aloof.
scenario.speaker1_persona: John is generally perceptive and empathetic. He's good at noticing changes in people's behavior and addressing them in a thoughtful and non-confrontational manner.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Alex is aware of his emotions and can articulate them clearly. He's comfortable discussing his feelings and understands the value in doing so.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Alex struggles to identify and articulate his feelings. He's uncomfortable discussing his emotions, and often defaults to denial or deflection when confronted about them.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Alex is quick to anger and often reacts defensively when his emotional state is questioned. He struggles with emotional self-awareness and prefers to avoid discussing his feelings.
